in_sanskrit.name: भूपेन्द्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who rules over the earth. Bhupa means 'ruler' and Indra is the God of the earth.

in_hindi.name: भूपेन्द्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: Raja, which means king or ruler, combined with the Sanskrit term 'pendra', which translates to 'protector of the people'. Together, Bhupender means 'protector of the people'.

in_tamil.name: பூபேந்தர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Arasar, which means king or ruler, combined with the Sanskrit term 'pendra', which translates to 'protector of the people'. Together, Bhupender means 'protector of the people' in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: బూపేద౱ర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: Meedudu, which means king or ruler, combined with the Sanskrit term 'pendra', which translates to 'protector of the people'. Together, Bhupender means 'protector of the people' in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: Bhupendar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhupendar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhup means 'earth' and pendar means 'lord'. This name signifies being the ruler or owner of the earth.

in_bengali.name: Bhupendar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Earth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhupendar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bhup means 'earth' and pendar means 'lord'. This name signifies being the ruler or owner of the earth.
